## What changes and why

One subject per pull request.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credential, token, personal data or compound data
- [ ] No pipeline code, configuration or parameter
- [ ] Figures changed only in `data/numbers.json`, and `python scripts/gen_numbers.py --check` passes
- [ ] No em dash or en dash in text
- [ ] `python scripts/check_links.py` passes, and any link to the platform is listed in `data/site-links.json`
- [ ] Any new claim has a source and a date
